name: SDK Guide
description: Interactive tutorial that walks any user through the ResonantOS SDK using live, deterministic bridge-mediated calls. Replaces as a third workspace add-on via the generic registry mechanism — no Core changes required.
author: ResonantOS SDK-DEMO-001D
boundary: Replaceable SDK demonstration guide. Performs only deterministic round-trips through the bridge using the harness-messaging capability. Has no provider secrets, no wallet authority, no trusted-memory writes, and no filesystem writes. Every step shown to the user is a real cross-boundary call — show, do not tell.

routes.description: Guide runtime status — running, bridge identity, step count.
Deterministic echo used by the live demonstration step. Returns cross-boundary evidence (bridgeIdentity, addon, capability, receivedAt, messageCount).

Demonstration of an unauthorized request. The add-on does NOT declare wallet-signing; this route always returns 403 with the harness-messaging token check, proving the bridge enforces the capability contract end-to-end.
